correctness.rationale: Every 12-vertex icosahedral closed-neighborhood dominating pair is antipodal and lacks semitotal distance-two witnesses. The complete 220-triple enumeration in two independent implementations gives 60+20 feasible optimum triples, checks every adjacency-restricted and unrestricted one-vertex replacement, and performs breadth-first search from each of the 80 optima; exhaustive full-pair assertions give 480/300 edges and exactly 30 iff-characterized two-slide detours. Program sources and execution methods are supplied; no infinite claim made.

value.rationale: Semitotal domination is an independently motivated network-monitoring criterion between known ordinary domination and total domination. The polyhedral graph supports a natural classification into two exact optimum types (60 antipodal, 20 pairwise distance-two), and a sharp, fully characterized 30-pair two-move penalty for local rather than unrestricted optimal sensor relocation. This is structural and metric information beyond restating an existing bound; no general downstream theorem is claimed.
